title: Third-and-10, Tied Game
setup: January 20, 2019, NFC Championship in New Orleans. The Saints and Rams are tied 20-20 with 1:49 left. New Orleans faces third-and-10 at the Rams' 13. Rams cornerback Nickell Robey-Coleman sprints across the formation to cover wide-open receiver Tommylee Lewis. The ball arrives late, and Robey-Coleman hits Lewis before it gets there.
question: What do the officials do?
options: Flag defensive pass interference and give the Saints a first down.
ruling: No flag was thrown. The Saints settled for a field goal, the Rams forced overtime and won there. The NFL then made pass interference calls and non-calls subject to replay review, but it abandoned the expanded review after the 2019 season.
rulebookNote: The source names referee Bill Vinovich among those involved and describes the league's later replay-review change and its end after one season.
